For odd numbers, \((2m+1)^2-(2n+1)^2 = 4\big[m(m+1)-n(n+1)\big]\), and each product of consecutive integers is even, so the difference is a multiple of \(8\). Finally \((2k-1)(2k+1)+1 = 4k^2-1+1 = (2k)^2\), a perfect square, so only the second and third statements are correct.

Cross-multiplying gives \(4x^2-4x-24 = 3x^2+6x-24\), that is \(x^2-10x = 0\). The root \(x = 0\) would make the numbers of days negative, so \(x = 10\), and indeed \(\dfrac{12\times 7}{14\times 8} = \dfrac34\).
